sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 29.08.2024 in
connection with Jogta P.S. Case No. 16 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. No. 1983 of 2024 (S.T. No. 62
of 2025) for the offences registered under Sections 376/385/504/506/34 of the Ipc, pending in the
court of learned Additional Sessions Judge- X, Dhanbad.

3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner has made the following submissions: -
a.

The bail application of the petitioner was withdrawn earlier on 04.12.2024 and thereafter his bail application was dismissed by a co-ordinate Bench of this court on 25.09.2025 in B.A. No. 4221 of 2025.
b. The learned counsel has placed the FIR and has submitted that as per the FIR itself, the case has Vikash Singh @ Vikash Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

1 been lodged on 28.05.2023 on the apprehension that the informant would implicate the petitioner in a false case of carrying prostitution.
However, it transpired from the FIR itself that it has been alleged that the accused persons including the petitioner had forcibly committed rape upon the informant.

c. Prior to the present FIR, another FIR was lodged by the family member of one of the co-accused in connection with the incident on 20.05.2023 for offence publishable under Section 366-A read with Section 120B and Section 372 of IPC and 6 ( 2026:JHHC:8626 ) and 17 of the POCSO Act and under Section 5 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956.
It is submitted that the informant of the present case as well as her husband have been convicted in the said case and they are in custody.

The learned counsel has also placed the examination-in-chief of the informant-victim in the said case and has submitted that informant of the said case is involved in illegal activities and therefore the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
d. The learned counsel has submitted that the petitioner is the whistle blower in connection with numerous cases relating to theft of coal.

He has referred to the various e-mails which has been communicated by the petitioner to the authority's alleging theft of coal and has submitted that a CID report was also prepared indicating that the allegations regarding theft of coal against the informant party and others have been found to be correct.

e. The learned counsel has also submitted that the informant of the present case has also written a letter from the jail and in that letter she has not supported the FIR and has stated that under the pressure of her husband, she has lodged the case.
f. The learned counsel has also submitted that next date for examination of witness in the case is 06.04.2026 and the victim has already been examined before the learned court.
However, the deposition of the victim has not been placed on record by the petitioner.
4. The learned counsel for the informant has also appeared and he has not opposed the prayer for bail, rather he sought time to file a counter affidavit in this case.

5. Learned counsel for the opposite party-State has opposed the prayer and has submitted that the bail application of the petitioner was rejected earlier and the trial is at the fag end and he submits that the witnesses will be promptly produced before the court.

6. After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, this court is of the ( 2026:JHHC:8626 ) view that the arguments which have been advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner touching upon the merit of the case and inter-se rivalry cannot be considered at this stage and any pronouncement by this court on such materials may have a bearing in the trial.
7. However, the fact remains that the bail application of the petitioner was rejected by a co-ordinate Bench of this court earlier by also referring that the petitioner has criminal antecedents.

The impugned order dated 17.02.2026 reveals that the trial is at the advanced stage and 6 out of 9 charge sheeted witnesses have already been examined and the next date fixed in this case is 06.04.2026.
In view of the fact that bail application was rejected earlier and trial is at the advanced stage, this court is not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, prayer for bail of the petitioner above named is rejected.
